name: Internet Archive Scholar
description: Search engine over the Internet Archive's collection of preserved open access research papers, indexing full text and metadata from journals, repositories, and web archives.

name: ResearchGate
description: Professional network for researchers where authors share publications, preprints, and datasets, with question and answer threads and publication statistics.

name: Academia.edu
description: Platform where academics upload and share papers, follow research topics, and track readership, organized around author profiles and paper listings.

name: Scite
description: Platform that classifies citation statements as supporting, contrasting, or mentioning, helping researchers see how later work has cited a paper.
access_requirements: Limited free search; subscription required for full citation reports

name: OpenAIRE Research Graph
description: Open metadata graph linking publications, datasets, software, funders, and organizations, aggregated by the OpenAIRE infrastructure from repositories and data archives.

name: Inciteful
description: Free tool that builds citation networks around a seed paper to surface related work, review papers, and bridge papers that connect fields of study.

name: Karlsruhe Virtual Catalog (KVK)
description: Meta search service operated by Karlsruhe Institute of Technology that simultaneously queries hundreds of library catalogs and bibliographic databases worldwide.

name: Library of Congress Linked Data Service
description: Authority and vocabulary service from the Library of Congress that provides resolvable URIs for names, subjects, and formats, with machine readable RDF and JSON-LD representations.

name: data.bnf.fr
description: Linked data service of the French national library that exposes bibliographic records, authority data, and subjects as RDF with a SPARQL query endpoint.

name: Dublin Core Metadata Initiative
description: Standards organization that maintains the Dublin Core metadata element set and related specifications for describing digital and physical resources across domains.

name: DataCite Search
description: Search interface over DOIs registered through DataCite, covering datasets, software, samples, and other research outputs from member repositories worldwide.

name: BMC
description: Open access publisher of peer-reviewed journals across biology, medicine, and related disciplines, founded as BioMed Central and now part of Springer Nature.

name: SpringerOpen
description: Springer Nature's open access imprint, hosting peer-reviewed fully open access journals across science, medicine, engineering, and the humanities and social sciences.

name: PeerJ
description: Open access publisher of peer-reviewed journals covering biology, medicine, and computer science, with options for open publication of peer review history.

name: F1000Research
description: Open science publishing platform that publishes refereed research papers, protocols, and posters with open peer review and rapid, versioned publication.

name: Ubiquity Press
description: Open access publisher and hosting platform for fully open access peer-reviewed journals, many run by university libraries and scholarly societies.

name: Open Book Publishers
description: Independent open access academic publisher of peer-reviewed books in the humanities and social sciences, offering free PDF and HTML editions alongside print.

name: EMBO Press
description: Publishing platform of the European Molecular Biology Organization, issuing peer-reviewed open access journals covering molecular biology and the life sciences.

name: Public Knowledge Project
description: University based research and development initiative providing free open source publishing platforms, including Open Journal Systems and Open Monograph Press.

name: UCL Press
description: Open access university press of University College London, publishing peer-reviewed monographs, textbooks, and journals with free digital editions.

name: SportRxiv
description: Open access preprint service for kinesiology, sport, exercise, and health research, hosted on the Open Science Framework with moderated postings.

name: PhilSci Archive
description: Sponsored archive of preprints in the philosophy of science maintained at the University of Pittsburgh, covering conceptual and historical foundations of the sciences.

name: Authorea
description: Collaborative writing and preprint hosting platform for research manuscripts, figures, and datasets, with versioning and journal submission templates, owned by Wiley.

name: eCommons
description: Cornell University's open access institutional repository collecting faculty and student scholarship, preprints, reports, and conference materials.

name: ScholarlyCommons
description: University of Pennsylvania's institutional repository hosting faculty publications, dissertations, technical reports, and library maintained open access journals.

name: Princeton DataSpace
description: Princeton University's institutional repository for research outputs, including faculty publications, senior theses, and research datasets.

name: University Digital Conservancy
description: University of Minnesota's institutional repository preserving and sharing institutional scholarship, theses, dissertations, and published research outputs.

name: Carolina Digital Repository
description: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill's institutional repository for faculty publications, theses, dissertations, and archival research materials.
publisher: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

name: Brown Digital Repository
description: Brown University's repository for scholarly output, including theses, dissertations, publications, and digitized archival collections.

name: MeSH Browser
description: Official browser for Medical Subject Headings, the National Library of Medicine controlled vocabulary used to index PubMed, with descriptors, qualifiers, and supplementary concept records.

name: NCBI E-utilities
description: HTTP API suite for querying NCBI databases such as PubMed, PMC, Gene, and Taxonomy, supporting search, record fetching, and cross database linking of biomedical records.

name: Virtual Health Library
description: Portal of the Virtual Health Library network operated by BIREME, integrating biomedical literature from LILACS, MEDLINE, and regional and institutional health sources.

name: Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry (ANZCTR)
description: Primary registry of clinical trials undertaken in Australia, New Zealand, and beyond, accepted as a WHO ICTRP partner registry for prospective trial registration.
publisher: NHMRC Clinical Trials Centre, University of Sydney

name: NOMAD
description: European open science platform for materials science data, hosting a large repository of computed and experimental materials datasets with analysis tools and a REST API.

name: Materials Cloud
description: Open platform for sharing computational materials science data, hosting curated archives of simulation inputs, outputs, and workflows tied to published research.

name: Crystallography Open Database (COD)
description: Open access collection of crystal structures of organic, inorganic, metal-organic compounds, and minerals, searchable online and downloadable in CIF format.

name: LMFDB
description: Database of L-functions, modular forms, elliptic curves, number fields, and related objects in number theory, with cross links between mathematical structures.

name: MacTutor History of Mathematics Archive
description: Biographies of mathematicians, histories of mathematical topics, and curve and chronology reference material maintained by the University of St Andrews.

name: ChEBI
description: Manually curated dictionary of small chemical entities of biological relevance, providing nomenclature, structure data, and ontology classification with programmatic access.

name: Stanford Network Analysis Project (SNAP)
description: Stanford research group publishing graph and network datasets and software tools, including large social and information network collections used in research and teaching.

name: MS MARCO
description: Microsoft dataset collection for machine reading comprehension, question answering, and passage ranking, built from real web search queries, with associated benchmarks.

name: PyTorch Hub
description: Repository of pre-trained models for PyTorch that supports publication, discovery, and one-line loading of reproducible trained models through the torch.hub interface.

name: LMArena
description: Public platform where users compare outputs from large language models in blind head-to-head battles, producing model rankings based on crowdsourced human preference votes.

name: conda-forge
description: Community led channel of the conda packaging ecosystem providing thousands of build-managed, cross-platform packages for scientific and data computing.

name: pkg.go.dev
description: Google operated site for discovering, publishing, and reading documentation for Go modules, with package search, version history, and license information.

name: Hex
description: Package registry for the Elixir and Erlang ecosystems, hosting published packages with version management, documentation publishing, and a documented API.

name: NixOS Search
description: Official search interface over the Nixpkgs collection, listing package versions, descriptions, licenses, and supported platforms for the Nix package manager.

name: SourceForge
description: Long running open source software hosting directory providing project pages, file distribution, and download mirrors for thousands of open source projects.

name: Codeberg
description: Nonprofit code hosting platform run by Codeberg e.V., offering Git repositories, issue tracking, and collaboration tools built on the Forgejo software.

name: Julia General Registry
description: Official package server for the Julia language, serving the General registry that indexes community packages and version metadata for the Pkg package manager.

name: NumPy Documentation
description: Official documentation for NumPy, the foundational Python library for array computing, including tutorials, reference pages, and guides on arrays, ufuncs, and linear algebra.

name: pandas Documentation
description: Official documentation for the pandas Python library for data analysis, covering data structures, indexing, time series, and input output tools, with tutorials and an API reference.

name: SciPy Documentation
description: Official documentation for SciPy, the Python library for scientific computing, with reference pages and tutorials on optimization, integration, statistics, and signal processing.

name: Matplotlib Documentation
description: Official documentation for Matplotlib, the Python plotting library, with tutorials, an API reference, galleries of examples, and guides for static and interactive figures.

name: Django Documentation
description: Official documentation for the Django web framework, covering tutorials, topic guides, reference material, and how-to guides for models, views, templates, and security.

name: React Documentation
description: Official documentation for React, the JavaScript library for building user interfaces, with guides on components, hooks, state management, and current React APIs.

name: Git Documentation
description: Official documentation for the Git version control system, including the reference manual, the Pro Git book, videos, and command cheat sheets.

name: Read the Docs
description: Documentation hosting platform that builds and publishes versioned documentation from version control for open source and commercial projects, with a REST API and search.
access_requirements: Free for open source projects; paid plans for commercial use

name: PyTorch Documentation
description: Official documentation for PyTorch, the machine learning framework, including the API reference, tutorials on tensors and neural networks, and guides to distributed training.

name: Julia Documentation
description: Official documentation for the Julia programming language, including the manual, the standard library reference, and guides on types, performance, and parallel computing.

name: TypeScript Documentation
description: Official documentation for TypeScript, Microsoft's typed superset of JavaScript, with handbooks on types, generics, modules, and compiler configuration.

name: Linux Kernel Documentation
description: Official documentation for the Linux kernel hosted on kernel.org, covering kernel builds, APIs, driver development, and subsystem documentation in HTML format.

name: Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF)
description: Open standards organization that develops Internet standards, most notably the RFC series, through working groups and rough consensus processes.

name: Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA)
description: Authority that coordinates Internet protocol resources, including protocol parameter registries, root zone management, and assigned number allocations, operated as part of ICANN.

name: WHATWG
description: Community that develops and maintains the core web Living Standards, including HTML, DOM, Fetch, and URL, using an open, pull request based process.
publisher: Web Hypertext Application Technology Working Group

name: Unicode Consortium
description: Standards body that maintains the Unicode Standard for text representation, including character encoding tables, normalization algorithms, and related specifications such as CLDR locale data.

name: Khronos Group
description: Open consortium that defines royalty-free graphics, compute, vision, and sensor interchange standards, including OpenGL, Vulkan, OpenCL, and glTF.

name: ETSI
description: European Telecommunications Standards Institute, which produces telecommunications, broadcasting, and ICT standards, with most published standards freely downloadable.

name: ASTM International
description: International standards organization that develops and publishes voluntary consensus technical standards for materials, products, systems, and services across many industries.
access_requirements: Most standards documents must be purchased

name: GS1
description: Global standards organization that maintains identification standards for products, locations, and shipments, including barcodes, GTINs, and electronic product data exchange.

name: HL7 International
description: Standards development organization for health information technology interoperability, best known for the HL7 v2, CDA, and FHIR data exchange standards.
access_requirements: Many current standards are freely available online; some content requires membership

name: DICOM
description: Organization that maintains the DICOM standard for storing, transmitting, and sharing medical imaging information and related data across equipment and systems.

name: National Information Standards Organization (NISO)
description: United States based nonprofit that develops and maintains standards for information services, publishing, and library technology, including metadata, identifiers, and access protocols.

name: protocols.io
description: Repository of step by step research methods where researchers can record, share, and version laboratory procedures, with DOIs for citable protocol versions.

name: Zooniverse
description: Platform for people powered research that hosts citizen science projects in which volunteers classify images, transcribe records, and contribute data to academic studies.

name: Rayyan
description: Web based tool for screening and deduplicating references in systematic reviews, with collaboration, blinding, and suggested relevance ordering for candidate studies.
access_requirements: Free basic use; paid premium features

name: Covidence
description: Cloud platform that supports title and abstract screening, full text review, risk of bias assessment, and data extraction for systematic and living reviews.
access_requirements: Subscription based; institutional and individual plans available

name: SciCrunch
description: Registry and search platform for Research Resource Identifiers, helping authors cite antibodies, model organisms, tools, and software unambiguously in biomedical papers.

name: American Statistical Association (ASA)
description: Professional society for statisticians and data scientists that publishes journals, ethical guidelines, and statements on statistical practice and p-value interpretation.

name: Royal Statistical Society (RSS)
description: United Kingdom professional body for statistics and data science that publishes journals, a code of professional conduct, and guidance on statistical practice and data ethics.

name: Council for International Organizations of Medical Sciences (CIOMS)
description: Body co-founded by WHO and UNESCO that issues international guidance on biomedical research ethics, including work with human participants and laboratory animal welfare.
publisher: Council for International Organizations of Medical Sciences

name: CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy)
description: Taxonomy of fourteen contributor roles maintained by NISO that describes each person's role in a research output, widely adopted by journals for author contribution statements.

name: NC3Rs
description: United Kingdom scientific organization that funds research and publishes guidelines supporting the replacement, refinement, and reduction of animal use in research.

name: World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)
description: United Nations agency that administers international intellectual property treaties, provides policy resources, and operates services for patents, trademarks, and designs.

name: European Patent Office (EPO)
description: Executive arm of the European Patent Organisation that examines and grants European patents and provides patent data services, legal resources, and examination guidelines.

name: European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO)
description: European Union agency responsible for registering European Union trade marks and designs, with public search services for EU trademark and design registrations.

name: China National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA)
description: English portal of China's national authority for patents, trademarks, and geographical indications, providing policy news, legal texts, and filing guidance.

name: CERT/CC Vulnerability Notes Database
description: Public database of vulnerability notes from the CERT Coordination Center documenting software flaws, their impact, workarounds, and vendor solutions.
publisher: Software Engineering Institute, Carnegie Mellon University

name: JPCERT/CC
description: Japan's computer security incident response team, publishing vulnerability advisories, threat reports, and coordination notices with vendors and international CERTs.

name: RustSec Advisory Database
description: Security advisory database for Rust crates that publishes machine readable vulnerability reports and supports tooling such as cargo audit for dependency auditing.

name: Snyk Vulnerability Database
description: Publicly searchable database of vulnerabilities in open source packages and container images, curated by Snyk with severity scoring and fix version guidance.

name: Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS)
description: Official home of the Common Vulnerability Scoring System maintained by FIRST, providing the specification, calculators, and user guides for scoring vulnerability severity.
publisher: Forum of Incident Response and Security Teams (FIRST)

name: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED)
description: NASA funded database of extragalactic objects that combines positions, redshifts, photometry, spectra, and literature references across the electromagnetic spectrum.

name: NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA)
description: NASA archive for infrared and adjacent wavelength astronomy data, hosting datasets from missions such as Spitzer, WISE, and 2MASS with search and programmatic services.

name: ESASky
description: Science discovery interface from the European Space Agency giving unified access to mission archives including Gaia, XMM-Newton, and Herschel, with visualization and cross mission queries.

name: American Association of Variable Star Observers (AAVSO)
description: Association of amateur and professional astronomers that collects and distributes photometric observations of variable stars and supports time domain astronomy research.
publisher: American Association of Variable Star Observers

name: Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS)
description: Multi institution astronomical survey that publishes optical and infrared imaging and spectroscopy of the sky through public data releases and catalog archives.

name: JPL Horizons System
description: Solar system ephemeris and orbital element service from the Jet Propulsion Laboratory providing positions, velocities, and rise and set times for planets, moons, asteroids, and comets.

name: NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA)
description: NASA's permanent archive for space science mission data, providing mission information, master catalogs, and historical data from space physics and astronomy missions.

name: ESO Science Archive Facility
description: Archive of raw and reduced observations from European Southern Observatory telescopes including the VLT, with catalog queries and programmatic data access.

name: NASA Open APIs
description: Portal for NASA's public web APIs, including astronomy picture feeds, Earth imagery, and near-Earth object data, with a single registration key for programmatic access.

name: Vera C. Rubin Observatory
description: Survey facility in Chile built to conduct the decade long Legacy Survey of Space and Time, delivering wide field sky imaging data releases to the astronomy community.
